reviews.t: Fast heating elements and it gets nice and hot

reviews.t: Lightweight and easy to handle hair dryer
reviews.x: I purchased this blow dryer from Amazon. This is an Infraed Ionic Hair dryer. It has two speeds and three heat settings. It comes with three attachments.A difusser, a comb and a narrow head. It has a nice long cord 5-6 ft. It usually takes five minutes to dry my hair and the hairdryer does not get hot. It is easy to handle. And it has a loop on it to hang it easily. I think this dryer was priced average. I like this product a lot and I would recommend it.

It also comes with 3 different attachments which is really awesome to apply on different hair length. overall, we really love the item. its high quality made product.

reviews.t: I'm sensitive to the heat and hated drying my hair because it means blasting hot air ...
reviews.x: This dryer is incredible. I'm sensitive to the heat and hated drying my hair because it means blasting hot air at my skull for what seemed like forever, only to leave me with a dry but frizzy poof. The red light in this dryer truly cut the time it takes my hair to dry down to 5-10 minutes, which has left it feeling less dried out and damaged as well. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Great dryer, but really wished the air flow nozzle ...
reviews.x: Great dryer, but really wished the air flow nozzle stayed on. It falls off instantly if I touch it at all. I can probably rig it up, but wish I didn't have to. Otherwise, this dryer is excellent and really reduces drying time and flyaways.

Only had a couple months and the darn thing started having a burning smell. Next the slow settkng became fast, and fast is fast. Still burning smell after a minute of use. Frustrated that it's unsafe now....!
I have very thick, long hair and this is the first hairdryer I have had that can get my hair dry in a reasonable amount of time.  For anyone with thick hair, this hair drier is worth the price.
I like how it straightened my hair and less time to completely dry my 4c natural hair

I lost the diffuser end of my old me, and since it was like 10 years old I thought I was due for an update. Love this thing! I like to use no heat for most of the drying and then a low heat to finish and hate having to hold the button because sometimes you have to hold the dryer in a writes position...not with this! THie has three included attachments as well as various options in terms of heat settings as well as output settings. My wife loved these settings which lets you infuse a cold shot after using hot air. The two attachments she liked the best is the concentrated attachment and the straightener attachment. They help professionally drying your hair.

reviews.t: The jury's still out on this one.
reviews.x: I bought this to replace my Chi blow dryer.  This product has a decent weight and doesn't feel flimsy, but on the other hand it doesn't feel quite balanced like the Chi.  This unit is more 'high tech' than the dryer it replaced, but I'm not convinced it does a better job or lives up to its claims.  If you're looking for high power this definitely would fit the bill.  I felt like I was drying my hair with a leaf blower.

This is a great purchase!  Who knew a hairdryer could make such a difference? 1. Arrived on time and in good condition. 2. Very affordable. 3. This seriously makes my hair 10x softer, smoother, and shinier than my previous hair dryer.  I really didn't believe there was much difference between hairdryer technologies - or if there was, I though I'd have to shell out major bucks.  Highly recommend it.

Seems nice. Great for people who overheat when they dry their hair. Can use the cooler setting. I haven't put a lot of time into it because im always running late, but it dries my bangs well (with a brush), then i'm on my way.  I do not regret the purchase. It was necessary. My past dryer lasted a long time then one day it started making scary noises and shooting flames.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the fast heating and quick drying time, especially for thick or curly hair.
Several reviewers complain that the attachments, particularly the concentrator nozzle and diffuser, do not stay on the dryer.
Some reviewers report durability and safety problems, including the dryer dying or developing a burning smell within months.
Reviewers appreciate the included attachments and long cord as useful features.
A few reviewers criticize the design, citing heaviness and poorly placed controls that are easy to accidentally change.
